ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 cancellation fee (driver's $4.50 share stands); note the ride was a RydeX no-show cancellation.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the two chat messages are pickup logistics and a cancellation notice (F9, F10); the rider's complaint and the driver's statement (F12) contain no threat, abuse, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation. safety_concern = none.

Branch: cancelled_by = driver who alleges rider no-show → NS-0 routes to NS-1. (i) Arrival: the platform recorded driver arrival at 09:53:25 [F5] and the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 09:54:15 [F6]. (ii) At the moment of the tap the driver was 40 m from the pickup point [F6], well within 200 m (G2), and the closest approach was 38 m [F1] — the earlier platform arrival at 09:53:25 also placed him within 200 m [F2, F5]. (iii) Continuous waiting after the tap: the driver stayed within 200 m for 3 min 5 s after the tap [F6], i.e. ≥ 3:01, and the car was stationary at 39 m from pickup from 09:53:55 to 09:57:20 [F3]; the total time within 200 m before cancellation was 3 min 55 s [F2]. Free-wait duration is not used as a threshold. GPS coverage is continuous across the wait (no gap flagged), so no G12 referral is needed.

The rider's complaint that "by the time I came out he had cancelled" does not defeat the fee: the record shows the driver was on location and waited past three minutes before cancelling, and no record (no speed-band or incident facts, F13/F14) supports any contrary excuse. All three NS-1 elements are satisfied, so the $6.61 fee stands and no refund is due. NS-7's 30-day window is not an issue since the dispute was filed in time; the fee is simply upheld.

Profile: the driver has no-show disputes upheld before (F17) and the rider none (F16), but profile facts cannot decide a case and here they are not needed. RD-6 is not triggered (no route deviation; a no-show cancellation is not a route-deviation refund > 0). No I'm-Here abuse: the driver was genuinely within 200 m at the tap [F6], so NS-2's flag_account step is not applicable.

rejected_claims.reason: The rider's account that the driver had already cancelled when she came out is contradicted by the system records: platform arrival 09:53:25 [F5], 'I'm Here' tap 09:54:15 at 40 m [F6], stationary at 39 m from pickup 09:53:55–09:57:20 [F3], cancellation at 09:57:20 [F4]. GPS/timeline overrides the statement, and NS-1 (i)–(iii) are met, so the $6.61 fee is valid.
The driver's written statement (F12) merely restates the record and is not needed; the finding rests on system records (F2–F6), not on his assertion.
